Specification: This module is a small test specification for TLA+ function application and related value expressions. It checks, through the invariant Inv, that function constructors and record-style application behave as expected, using TLC operators Assert and Print to report success or failure of individual tests. The active part of the file models a trivial one-variable system where x is fixed at 1, with Type constraining the state, Init initializing x, and Next stuttering; many additional test cases are present but commented out and therefore not extracted as active syntax.
IfThenElse: IF [i \in {3, 2, 1} |-> i+1][3] # 4 THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 1") ELSE Print("Test 1", TRUE)
IF [a |-> 1, b |-> 42, c |-> 99]["b"] # 42 THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 3" ) ELSE Print("Test 3" , TRUE)
